fields.label: Description
fields.description: Short DocType description (shown under the list and in the DocType list)

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Lucide icon for the menu and Workspace

fields.label: Module
fields.description: Pick an App first

fields.label: Autoname
fields.description: Series (CONTR-.YYYY.-.####), field:fieldname, prompt or hash

fields.label: Title field
fields.description: Which field is shown as the document title (default: name)

fields.label: Default view
fields.options:
list|LayoutList
kanban|LayoutGrid
calendar|CalendarDays
gantt|ChartGantt
tree|GitBranch
gallery|Image
map|Map

fields.label: Image field
fields.description: An Image or Attach field for the document avatar

fields.label: Child (Child Table)
fields.description: Used inside another DocType's Table field

fields.label: Singleton
fields.description: Only one document of this type (settings, profile)

fields.label: Virtual
fields.description: No physical table — data comes from a controller

fields.label: Submittable
fields.description: Adds a Submit button and a docstatus field

fields.label: Track changes
fields.description: Keep a document version on every save

fields.label: Track views (who opened the document)
fields.description: Remember which users have already opened the document (_seen column)

fields.label: View log
fields.description: Log every document open to ViewLog (at most once per hour per user)

fields.label: Trash (restore deleted)
fields.description: Keep a JSON snapshot of the document in DeletedDocument on delete, for later restore

fields.label: Quick entry (dialog)
fields.description: "Create" opens a mini-dialog with the required fields instead of the full form

fields.label: Beta
fields.description: Show a "Beta" badge — this DocType is still under development

fields.label: Deprecated
fields.description: Show a warning — kept for compatibility, do not use in new code

fields.label: Search fields
fields.description: Fields for full-text search in the list view (name is added automatically)

fields.label: Table name
fields.description: This type's physical table in the database

fields.label: Document actions
fields.description: Buttons in the form toolbar. Each row binds an action registered by the app in code (@doc_action).

fields.label: Document links
fields.description: Related document types on the form's Links panel. If empty, links are derived automatically from reverse Link fields.

fields.label: Is tree
fields.description: Enables the hierarchical view and TreeSelect widget

fields.label: Parent field
fields.description: Link field pointing at this same DocType (node hierarchy)

fields.label: Node title field
fields.description: Which field to show as the node label (default: title field)

fields.label: "As of" date field
fields.description: Date field that enables the date picker in the tree panel

fields.label: Sidebar on the form
fields.description: Show the details / tags / links panel next to the form

fields.label: Status field
fields.description: The DocType field that holds the document status (e.g. "status")

fields.label: Columns field
fields.description: Select field whose values group the kanban columns (default: first Select field in the list view)

fields.label: Date field
fields.description: Primary Date/Datetime field that places the event on the calendar

fields.label: End date field
fields.description: Event end Date/Datetime field (for multi-day events)

fields.label: Title field
fields.description: Event label (default: title field)

fields.label: Extra sources
fields.description: Other document types overlaid on this calendar

fields.label: Start field
fields.description: Date/Datetime field where the bar starts

fields.label: End field
fields.description: Date/Datetime field where the bar ends

fields.label: Title field
fields.description: Row/bar label (default: title field)

fields.label: Progress field (0–100)
fields.description: Float/Int/Percent — bar fill

fields.label: Colour map
fields.description: {"In progress": "#f59e0b", "Done": "#16a34a"}

fields.label: Default colour
fields.description: #2563eb or var(--primary)

fields.label: Dependencies field
fields.description: A text field listing predecessor document names, comma-separated — arrows are drawn between them
